QuestInfo.name: [Collector's Request] Wiz's Ancient Book
QuestInfo.0: Wiz the Librarian was happy when you said you came for Sayram's ancient book.
QuestInfo.1: Wiz the Librarian had no way to prove the information about Sayram other than what's in the book. He willingly hands the ancient book on Sayram's legend to you and tells you about a rumor that his last whereabouts were in #bLeafre#k. Go see #bChief Tatamo#k in Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: You went to Leafre and met Chief Tatamo. Will he know more?

0.0: I've been hoping its news would attract visitors! So there I was cleaning the archives, when what did I spy with my Laser-sharp Mental Book Radar?
0.1: That's right! A tome of heroic tales featuring none other than the #bGreat Warrior Sayram#k himself. He is the only Warrior to ever master every Warrior class such as Hero, Paladin, and Dark Knight.
0.2: Enthralled by the tale, I searched for more about what happened to Sayram, but alas, the trail ran cold.
0.3: As it stands, we can't be sure if #bhe actually existed#k. The tale is simply far too tall, and the evidence far too lacking.
0.4: Though there is only so much a super librarian can do from their lair, of course. Maybe you'll have better luck.
0.5: Here, I'll entrust you with this book for now. It's believed Sayram was last seen in a small town called #bLeafre#k somewhere in Ossyria. I'd ask the #bchief#k there if he knows anything.
0.6: Let me whisk you away to #bLeafre#k right away. Best of luck in your pursuit of the truth, my young friend.\r\n#b#e(Accept to move to the next quest location.)#n#k

1.0: Hm? Do you have any business here in Leafre?
